## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Database/RLS gates run when relevant
- [ ] Browser behavior verified when user-visible

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is narrowly scoped and has an issue or clear rationale
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated artifacts, or environment files are included
- [ ] New dependencies and GitHub Actions are justified and pinned
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include abuse cases and rollback notes
